name: Greenfiltec Ltd.
summary: Greenfiltec Ltd. is a Taiwan-based company, established in 2014 and headquartered in Taoyuan City, that provides advanced solutions for the prevention and control of airborne molecular contaminants (AMC) to the semiconductor and panel industries worldwide. Their extensive product range includes various specialized filtration systems such as modular and panel-type chemical filters, cartridge filters, magnetic adhesion filter frames, V-shaped panel filters, high-capacity multi-function filters, mobile micro-pollution filtration systems, and ChemFFU systems. Additionally, they offer AMC measurement and analysis tools. Greenfiltec also delivers comprehensive services, encompassing filter installation and replacement, total AMC management, and custom AOI/OM (Automated Optical Inspection/Optical Microscopy) solutions. Their primary customers are wafer foundries, panel manufacturers, and dynamic random access memory (DRAM) producers.
